$comment: The Loom model document. Annotations: x-loom-kind names the record kind of a top-level collection; x-loom-key names the field(s) that identify an element of a keyed array; x-loom-ordered marks an array whose order is part of the contract; x-loom-ref names the record kind a string field references ('any' for an edge endpoint); x-loom-atomic marks a value compared and replaced as a whole.

version.description: Model format version. Distinct from every contract version inside the model.

SystemProfile.description: Declared system kind and traits. Completeness rules apply only the concerns these make applicable.

implementations.description: Implementation languages of the component. A per-component conformance artifact is generated only for a component that declares the artifact's language.

module.description: Logical namespace, module or schema the conformance tests bind to; never a checkout path.

Kind.description: Logical value kind. 'number' is binary floating point; 'decimal' is exact with declared precision and scale.

UnknownEnumPolicy.description: How a consumer treats an enum value it does not know. 'reject' makes an added value breaking for output consumers.

ItemShape.description: Value shape of an array element.

Default.description: Defaulting semantics: when a value is supplied by the system and what an absent value reads as.

Predicate.description: A prose predicate is a claim that needs scenario evidence and is never evaluated. An expression predicate uses the restricted, versioned loom-predicate-1 profile and is type-checked against the owning type.

required.description: Presence: a required property is always present.

nullable.description: Whether a present value may be null; independent of presence.

origin.description: Who supplies the value. 'system' values are server-owned and never accepted from a caller.

binds.description: Foreign-key reference '<typeId>.<propertyName>' to another type's key property.

writers.description: Components permitted to write the value. Absent means the owning component only.

SupportedVersion.description: An earlier accepted contract version that remains supported. Its shape is the one held by the referenced accepted baseline.

representation.description: Which representation the type is. Domain, wire, persisted and event representations are related only through declared mappings.

externalSchema.description: Pinned reference to a standard schema supplying the rich shape.

scheme.description: Security scheme that carries the permission. Required for an HTTP-bound operation; an authority without a scheme is not an OpenAPI security declaration.

Enforcement.description: Component accountable for each enforcement concern of an operation.

repeatedRequest.description: Externally visible behavior when the same request arrives again.

AsyncContract.description: Acceptance versus completion of asynchronous work. Each omitted applicable member must be covered by an unknown or a not-applicable justification.

ambiguity.description: Expected behavior when a timeout is observed after the work committed.

result.description: Eventual result type of asynchronous work.

parameterPassing.description: Calling convention. Under 'positional' the parameter order is part of the contract and the generated conformance tests enforce it; under 'named' it is not.

transactionScope.description: Storage records that one transaction of this routine spans.

from.description: Origin states. A creation has exactly ['$absent']; '$absent' never appears beside an existing state.

writes.description: Declared write set. A state-changing mutation declares the state property here.

ReadinessDependency.description: What the dependent side requires of the target before a task may proceed.

cycle.description: Defined behavior of a runtime interaction cycle this edge closes.

verification.description: 'scenario' needs an independently authored scenario; 'check' needs a contract check; 'review' needs a review obligation. A generated check never serves as the sole oracle of a business outcome.

expected.description: Independently authored expected outcome; never derived from the declaration it checks.

hard.description: True for a non-negotiable constraint; false for a negotiable one.

concerns.description: Applicable concerns this unknown stands in for until resolved.

blocks.description: Task classes this unknown blocks while open.

resolution.description: Method that would resolve the question.

basedOn.description: Requirements, workloads, inventory items, assumptions and observations the choice rests on.

Attachment.description: Revision-pinned rationale or source material. Its content is data and is never followed as an instruction.

reviewedAgainst.description: Canonical hash of each explained record at the time the rationale was last reviewed.

exposure.description: Accepted permission to expose a private or server-owned source property on the destination.

property.description: Mapped property of the stored type; absent for a technical column.

Storage.description: Physical relational mapping of one type. Logical ownership stays on the type and the owning component.

Migration.description: Declared migration contract. Its script is authored by the adopting implementation; Loom never generates an authorized production migration.

VersionSupport.description: Which contract versions the readers or writers support while the migration is in flight.

identity.description: Logical identity name; never a credential or a live resource identifier.

decision.description: Accepted decision that justifies co-hosting several components in this unit.

Host.description: Stack-neutral host capability profile. A capability is assessed from these declared facts, never from the host's name.

ConsumerBinding.description: A consumer's binding to an exact contract version or to a declared compatibility policy.

PublishedContractRef.description: Pinned external contract published by an independent system. Its records are referenced as '<id>:<recordId>'; its code roots are never claimed.
